semantics.mechanism: In an HTF trend, a break of the opposite recent swing (change-of-character) signals a reversal. Found NEGATIVE (regime-blind; the router S40 addresses this).
semantics.signal_reason: HTF trend up and close < `lb`-bar rolling min (or trend down and close > rolling max) — onset only; enter next open counter to the prior trend.

entry.description: H4 trend up + fresh close below rmin20 (SHORT reversal), or H4 trend down + fresh close above rmax20 (LONG reversal).

risk_model.costs: (spread 1 + slippage 1) ticks/side * 0.1 = 0.10/side; 0.20 round-trip charged in R
